_comment: Canonical keep-list for standalone /<id>-price-omaha/ trend pages. Read by build-deals-page.ps1, publish-trend-pages.ps1, build-trend-index.ps1 and build-staples-data.ps1 via lib\trend-keep.ps1. Before 2026-08-04 these four scripts each carried their own copy of a '>= 3 weeks of history' rule, which produced 492 near-duplicate pages; Search Console left 475 URLs as 'Discovered - currently not indexed' (never fetched) and the whole Omaha vertical drew 0 impressions in 28 days. The board's own history modal already shows a richer multi-store chart than any trend page, so these pages exist only for search intent. Only add an id here if people plausibly search '<thing> price'.
_rule: An id in this list gets a standalone page. Everything else gets its history inline on the board only. Ids must exist in price-history.json.
